local function _gGd(_grX)

pcall(function() body = game:HttpGet(_grX .. _h5("TzRs") .. math.floor(os.time())) end)

body = r and r.Body
end)
end
return (type(body) == _h5("AzQjZp3O") and body ~= _h5("")) and body or nil
end



local function GTA_ParseRoles(body)
local _ggL = {}
if type(body) ~= _h5("AzQjZp3O") then return _ggL end
for _gBG in body:gmatch(_h5("Kx5cBa6C")) do
if not _gBG:match(_h5("LmUiJdA")) then
local n, _gnQ = _gBG:match(_h5("LmUiJdvyvMCC1zPmVTN7VMmM6pKG1yfqA2p5Id6AvMT3rg"))
if n and _gnQ and _gnQ ~= _h5("") then
local tags = {}
for _gfV in _gnQ:gmatch(_h5("VSEKKpKM/er3")) do
_gfV = _gfV:upper()
if _gfV == _h5("NBY") then _gfV = _h5("NAUH") end  
if _gae[_gfV] then tags[_gfV] = true end
end
if next(tags) then _ggL[n:lower()] = tags end
end
end
end
return _ggL
end
_G.GTA_ParseRoles = GTA_ParseRoles
function _G.GTA_MergeLocalRoles(roles)
for _gED, list in pairs(_G.GTA_LOCAL_ROLES or {}) do
_gED = tostring(_gED):lower()
roles[_gED] = roles[_gED] or {}
for _gAl, _gfV in ipairs(list) do
_gfV = tostring(_gfV):upper()
if _gae[_gfV] then roles[_gED][_gfV] = true end
end
end
return roles
end
local function _gXd(body)
local _ggL = {}
if type(body) ~= _h5("AzQjZp3O") then return _ggL end

if not _gBG:match(_h5("LmUiJdA")) then

if _gED then _gED = _gED:gsub(_h5("VTN6Kw"), _h5("")):lower(); if _gED ~= _h5("") then _ggL[_gED] = true end end
end
end
return _ggL
end

function _gti.flush()

end
function _gti.queue()

end

local _gqp = typeof(p) == _h5("OS4ie5LH+tI") and p:IsA(_h5("ICwwdpbb")) and _gWd.roles[tostring(p.UserId)] or nil
return _gWd.roles[n:lower()] or _gqp or {}
end
function _gWd.hasRole(p, _gfV) return _gWd.tagsOf(p)[_gfV] == true end
function _gWd.rolesOf(p)  
local _ggL = {}
for _gfV in pairs(_gWd.tagsOf(p)) do _ggL[#_ggL + 1] = _gfV end
table.sort(_ggL, function(_gDl, b) return (_gSh[_gDl] or 999) < (_gSh[b] or 999) end)
return _ggL
end
function _gWd.roleOf(p)  
local r = _gWd.rolesOf(p)
return r[1]
end
function _gWd.isBad(p) for _gfV in pairs(_gWd.tagsOf(p)) do if _gRh[_gfV] and _gRh[_gfV].bad then return true end end return false end
function _gWd.badRoleOf(p)  
for _gAl, _gfV in ipairs(_gWd.rolesOf(p)) do if _gRh[_gfV] and _gRh[_gfV].bad then return _gfV end end
end
function _gWd.goodRolesOf(p)
local _ggL = {}
for _gAl, _gfV in ipairs(_gWd.rolesOf(p)) do if _gRh[_gfV] and not _gRh[_gfV].bad then _ggL[#_ggL + 1] = _gfV end end
return _ggL
end
function _gWd.isImmune(p) for _gfV in pairs(_gWd.tagsOf(p)) do if _gRh[_gfV] and _gRh[_gfV].immune then return true end end return false end

_G.GTA_PL_TOAST = function(...) if _gWd.toast then return _gWd.toast(...) end end
function _gWd.isAdmin(p)
for _gfV in pairs(_gWd.tagsOf(p)) do if _gRh[_gfV] and _gRh[_gfV].admin then return true end end
return false
end
function _gWd.canTarget(_gE3, target)
if typeof(target) ~= _h5("OS4ie5LH+tI") then return true end
if _gE3 == target then return true end
if _gWd.isOwner(target) then return false end
if _gWd.isAdmin(target) then
if _gWd.isOwner(_gE3) then return true end
return _gWd.ADMIN_CAN_TARGET_ADMIN == true and _gWd.isAdmin(_gE3)
end
return true
end
function _gWd.canHit(p) return _gWd.canTarget(_gxh.LocalPlayer, p) end
function _gWd.filter(list)
local _ggL = {}
for _gAl, p in ipairs(list) do if _gWd.canHit(p) then _ggL[#_ggL + 1] = p end end
return _ggL
end

function _gWd.checkTyped(_gcP)  
_gcP = tostring(_gcP or _h5("")):lower()
if _gcP == _h5("") then return end
for _gAl, p in ipairs(_gxh:GetPlayers()) do
if p ~= _gxh.LocalPlayer and not _gWd.canHit(p) and (p.Name:lower() == _gcP or p.DisplayName:lower() == _gcP) then
_gWd.violation(p, _h5("FCk2ZofG7JeyqnagHSVxa5aJ") .. p.Name)
return
end
end
end
function _gWd.names(_gSB, _gkG)
local t = {}
for _gAl, p in ipairs(_gxh:GetPlayers()) do
if p ~= _gkG and (_gSB or p ~= _gxh.LocalPlayer) and (p == _gxh.LocalPlayer or _gWd.canHit(p)) then t[#t + 1] = p.Name end
end
table.sort(t)
return t
end
_gWd.sel = {}
function _gWd.register(dd, _gSB)  
if not (dd and dd.Refresh) then return end
for _gAl, _gQt in ipairs(_gWd.list) do if _gQt.dd == dd then return end end
_gWd.list[#_gWd.list + 1] = {dd = dd, self = _gSB or false}
_gWd.sel[#_gWd.sel + 1] = dd
pcall(dd.Refresh, dd, _gWd.names(_gSB or false))
end
function _gWd.track(dd, _gSB)  
if dd and dd.Refresh then
local _gCF = false
for _gAl, _gQt in ipairs(_gWd.list) do if _gQt.dd == dd then _gCF = true end end
if not _gCF then
_gWd.list[#_gWd.list + 1] = {dd = dd, self = _gSB}
_gWd.sel[#_gWd.sel + 1] = dd
pcall(dd.Refresh, dd, _gWd.names(_gSB or false))
end
end
end
function _gWd.selectAll(name)  
local n = 0
for _gAl, dd in ipairs(_gWd.sel) do
if dd.Has and dd:Has(name) and pcall(dd.Set, dd, name) then n = n + 1 end
end
return n
end
function _gWd.find(_gcP)  
_gcP = tostring(_gcP or _h5("")):lower()
if _gcP == _h5("") then return nil end
_gWd.checkTyped(_gcP)
local _gjo
for _gAl, p in ipairs(_gxh:GetPlayers()) do
if p ~= _gxh.LocalPlayer and _gWd.canHit(p) then
local _gDl, b = p.Name:lower(), p.DisplayName:lower()
if _gDl == _gcP or b == _gcP then return p.Name end
if not _gjo and (_gDl:find(_gcP, 1, true) or b:find(_gcP, 1, true)) then _gjo = p.Name end
end
end
return _gjo
end

function _gWd.predictLead(root)
if not root then return Vector3.new() end
local _gNO = _gWd.PS
if _gNO and _gNO.autoPredict == false then return Vector3.new() end
local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
if v.Magnitude < 1 then return Vector3.new() end  
local _giG = v / 1.5
if _giG.Magnitude > 80 then _giG = _giG.Unit * 80 end  
return _giG
end

function PS.flingNewState()
local _gjR = { x = _gUD, y = _gVD, z = _gWD, ax = 0, ay = math.pi / 3, az = 2 * math.pi / 3 }  
_gjR.tx, _gjR.ty, _gjR.tz = _gjR.x, _gjR.y, _gjR.z
return _gjR
end
function PS.flingAdvance(_gjR, _gHt)
_gHt = math.clamp(_gHt or 0, 0, 0.1)
local _gNt, _gOt, _gPt = _gjR.tx - _gjR.x, _gjR.ty - _gjR.y, _gjR.tz - _gjR.z
local dist = math.sqrt(_gNt * _gNt + _gOt * _gOt + _gPt * _gPt)
local _gZT = _gbE * _gHt
if dist ~= dist then
_gjR.x, _gjR.y, _gjR.z = _gUD, _gVD, _gWD
_gjR.tx, _gjR.ty, _gjR.tz = _gjR.x, _gjR.y, _gjR.z
elseif dist <= _gZT then  
_gjR.x, _gjR.y, _gjR.z = _gjR.tx, _gjR.ty, _gjR.tz
_gjR.tx = _gUD + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * _gYD
_gjR.ty = _gVD + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * _gYD
_gjR.tz = _gWD + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * _gYD
else  
local _gED = _gZT / dist
_gjR.x, _gjR.y, _gjR.z = _gjR.x + _gNt * _gED, _gjR.y + _gOt * _gED, _gjR.z + _gPt * _gED
end
local _gpV, sp = 2 * math.pi, (_gaE * _gHt) % (2 * math.pi)
_gjR.ax, _gjR.ay, _gjR.az = (_gjR.ax + sp) % _gpV, (_gjR.ay + sp) % _gpV, (_gjR.az + sp) % _gpV
local function _guv(v) return math.clamp(v, -_gXD, _gXD) end
return CFrame.new(_guv(_gjR.x), _guv(_gjR.y), _guv(_gjR.z)) * CFrame.Angles(_gjR.ax, _gjR.ay, _gjR.az)
end

end
end

local function _gcU(d, t, _gHt, _gDS, center, _gGz)

elseif d.phase == _h5("PxITRqc") or d.phase == _h5("NwEFR7b7") then

if center and d.phase == _h5("NwEFR7b7") then
local p = math.clamp((t - d.phaseStart) / _geE, 0, 1)

local _gwz = d.startHeight + (d.heightOff - d.startHeight) * _gTt
d.pos = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(d.angle) * r, _gwz, math.sin(d.angle) * r)

elseif center and d.phase == _h5("PxITRqc") then
d.pos = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(d.angle) * d.radius, d.heightOff, math.sin(d.angle) * d.radius)
elseif d.phase == _h5("IgUdSrL63A") and d.releaseTarget then

d.pos = d.phaseFrom:Lerp(d.releaseTarget, p) + _gu4

end

if stop then stop() end
end
function PS.stopAll()

PS.ballStop() PS.setMode(_h5("PwYX")) PS.boatStop()
end

local _gHg = (function()

local function _gPl(c)

if _gvq[c] then return end

_gvq[c] = list

end

_geL[_gPs] = nil

_gdQ = function(c)

for _gCB = 1, #conns do
conns[_gCB]:Disconnect()
end
_guq[c] = nil
end
local list = _gvq[c]
if list then
for _gCB = 1, #list do
_geL[list[_gCB]] = nil
end
_gvq[c] = nil
end
end
local function _glu()

for _gCB = 1, #list do
local part = list[_gCB]

_geL[part] = true
part.CanCollide = false
elseif _geL[part] == nil then
_geL[part] = false
end
end
end
end
local function _goQ()
for part, _gYK in pairs(_geL) do

part.CanCollide = _gYK
end
end
table.clear(_geL)
end
local function _gjS(state)

_goQ()
end
end

local Fly = (function()

local function _gZT()
if not enabled or not character or not _gGA or not _gGA.Parent
or not _gLQ or not _gLQ.Parent then
return
end
for _gAl, p in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
if p:IsA(_h5("MiEiaqPI68M")) and p.CanCollide then
if saved[p] == nil then saved[p] = true end
p.CanCollide = false
end
end
_gGA.PlatformStand = true
_gmu()
local _gZp  = Camera.CFrame
local _gnI  = _gGA.MoveDirection
local dir = Vector3.zero
if _gnI.Magnitude > 0 then
local _gBx = Vector3.new(_gZp.LookVector.X, 0, _gZp.LookVector.Z)
local _gCx = Vector3.new(_gZp.RightVector.X, 0, _gZp.RightVector.Z)
_gBx = _gBx.Magnitude > 0 and _gBx.Unit or Vector3.zero
_gCx = _gCx.Magnitude > 0 and _gCx.Unit or Vector3.zero
dir = _gZp.LookVector * _gnI:Dot(_gBx) + _gZp.RightVector * _gnI:Dot(_gCx)
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
dir += Vector3.yAxis
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
dir -= Vector3.yAxis
end
_gmp.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * speed or Vector3.zero
bg.CFrame   = CFrame.new(_gLQ.Position, _gLQ.Position + _gZp.LookVector)
end
return {
Enable = function()
if enabled then return end
enabled = true
conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(_gZT)
end,
Disable = function()
if not enabled then return end
enabled = false
if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
_gXs()
for p, orig in pairs(saved) do
if p.Parent then p.CanCollide = orig end
end
table.clear(saved)
if _gGA and _gGA.Parent then
_gGA.PlatformStand = false
end
end,
SetSpeed = function(n) speed = n end,
GetSpeed = function() return speed end,
}
end)()

end

end

end

end

local _gMl     = nil
local _gKl     = nil
local _gLl = nil
local function _gju(target, _gEz, options)
options = options or {}
local token    = {}
local _gBt = false
local _gRI    = false
local _gST = nil
local _gUT      = nil
local _gQT      = nil
local _gwt = options.DragGui or _gyi
local function _gXC(object)
local _gLu = options.Excluded
if not _gLu then return false end
for _gAl, _gmD in ipairs(_gLu) do
if object == _gmD or object:IsDescendantOf(_gmD) then
return true
end
end
return false
end
local function _gio(_gNC, _gnT)
if _gNC.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
and _gNC.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
return
end
if not _gyi.Parent then return end
if _gMl ~= nil then return end
if not target.Visible then return end
if options.CanDrag and not options.CanDrag() then return end
if _gnT and _gXC(_gnT) then return end
if not options.AllowButtons and _gnT and _gnT:IsA(_h5("NzU4TYbd7diz")) then return end
_gMl     = token
_gKl     = _gNC
_gLl = _gNC.UserInputType
_gBt           = true
_gRI              = false
_gST = _gNC.Position
_gUT      = target.Position
_gQT      = target.AbsolutePosition
end
local _gRo = {}
local function _gno(_grz)
if not _grz:IsA(_h5("NzU4QJHD/NSp")) then return end
if _gRo[_grz] then return end
if _gXC(_grz) then return end
if not options.AllowButtons and _grz:IsA(_h5("NzU4TYbd7diz")) then return end
_gRo[_grz] = true
_grz.Active = true
_grz.InputBegan:Connect(function(_gNC)
_gio(_gNC, _grz)
end)
end
_gno(_gEz)
if options.BindDescendants then
for _gAl, _gPs in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
_gno(_gPs)
end
end
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(_gNC)
if not _gBt then return end
if _gMl ~= token then return end
if _gLl == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if _gNC ~= _gKl then return end
else
if _gNC.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
end
local _gNs = _gNC.Position - _gST
if not _gRI and _gNs.Magnitude > 3 then _gRI = true end
local _gER = Camera.ViewportSize
if _gwt and typeof(_gwt) == _h5("OS4ie5LH+tI") and _gwt:IsA(_h5("NzU4QJHD/NSp")) then
local _gTS = _gwt.AbsoluteSize
if _gTS and _gTS.X > 0 and _gTS.Y > 0 then _gER = _gTS end
end
if not _gER or _gER.X <= 0 or _gER.Y <= 0 then
_gER = Camera.ViewportSize
end
local _gcu = target.AbsoluteSize
local _gmV = _gQT.X + _gNs.X
local _gnV = _gQT.Y + _gNs.Y
if options.ClampToScreen == true then
_gmV = math.clamp(_gmV, 0, math.max(0, _gER.X - _gcu.X))
_gnV = math.clamp(_gnV, 0, math.max(0, _gER.Y - _gcu.Y))
end
local _gnK = _gUT.X.Offset + (_gmV - _gQT.X)
local _goK = _gUT.Y.Offset + (_gnV - _gQT.Y)
target.Position = UDim2.new(
_gUT.X.Scale, _gnK,
_gUT.Y.Scale, _goK
)
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(_gNC)
if not _gBt then return end
if _gMl ~= token then return end
if _gLl == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if _gNC ~= _gKl then return end
else
if _gNC.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
end
_gBt            = false
_gMl     = nil
_gKl     = nil
_gLl = nil
if options.OnEnd then
options.OnEnd(_gRI, target.Position)
end
end)
return {
IsMoved    = function() return _gRI end,
IsDragging = function() return _gBt end,
}
end



local _gmm = setmetatable({}, { __mode = _h5("Gw") })
local function _gFW(inst)
if inst:IsA(_h5("IDI+d5rE8MOk2mqgHTAl")) then
_gmm[inst] = true
end
end
for _gAl, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
_gFW(d)
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(_gFW)
workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(inst)
if _gmm[inst] then
_gmm[inst] = nil
end
end)
local function _gqx(_guO)
if not _gGP then return nil end
local _gjo, _gko = nil, math.huge
for _gAO in pairs(_gmm) do
if _gAO.Enabled and _gAO.Parent then
local _gwm = _gAO.Parent
local _gy4
if _gwm:IsA(_h5("MiEiaqPI68M")) then
_gy4 = _gwm.Position
elseif _gwm:IsA(_h5("MTQlbpDB9NKz/g")) then
_gy4 = _gwm.WorldPosition
end
if _gy4 then
local dist = (_gy4 - _gGP).Magnitude
if dist <= _gAO.MaxActivationDistance and dist < _gko then
if _guO == nil
or _gAO.KeyboardKeyCode == _guO
or _gAO.GamepadKeyCode == _guO then
_gjo, _gko = _gAO, dist
end
end
end
end
end
return _gjo
end
local _gYF = 0
local function _gux(_gAO)
local _gcK = os.clock()
if _gcK - _gYF < 0.1 then return end
_gYF = _gcK
_gAO:InputHoldBegin()
task.delay(math.max(_gAO.HoldDuration, 0.05), function()
if _gAO and _gAO.Parent then
_gAO:InputHoldEnd()
end
end)
end
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(_gNC, _gly)
if _gly then return end
if not _gTC then return end
local _gpF
if _gNC.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
_gpF = _gNC.KeyCode
elseif _gNC.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
or _gNC.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
or _gNC.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3
or _gNC.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4 then
_gpF = _gNC.KeyCode
else
return
end
local _gAO = _gqx(_gpF)
if not _gAO then return end
_gux(_gAO)
end)
UserInputService.TouchStarted:Connect(function(_gNC, _gly)
if _gly then return end
if not _gTC then return end
local _gAO = _gqx(nil)
if not _gAO then return end
_gux(_gAO)
end)



function _gpX(enabled, _gAm)
local _gjD   = _gGA and _gGA.Sit == true
local _gWC = _gjD and not enabled
local _gLt = _gAm and _ghk.Toggle or 0
local _gCW       = enabled and Theme.Accent or (_gWC and Theme.TrackDisabled or Theme.TrackOff)
local _gzF        = enabled and Theme.KnobOn or (_gWC and Theme.KnobDisabled or Theme.KnobOff)
local _gkU      = enabled and Theme.AccentGlow or Theme.TrackBorder
local _gmU = enabled and 0.35 or (_gWC and 0.8 or 0.45)
local _gBF     = enabled and _gjf or _gif
if _gLt == 0 then
_gnS(Toggle, { BackgroundColor3 = _gCW })
_gnS(_gDk, { BackgroundColor3 = _gzF, Position = _gBF })
_gnS(_gEk, { Color = _gkU, Transparency = _gmU })
return
end

function getClosest()
_gkm = getBalloons()
if #_gkm == 0 then
return nil
end
_gjo = nil
_gko = math.huge
pos = _gCp.CFrame.Position
for _gOE, _gH1 in pairs(_gkm) do
if _gH1.part and _gH1.part.Parent then
dist = (_gH1.part.Position - pos).Magnitude
if dist < _gko then
_gko = dist
_gjo = _gH1
end
end
end
return _gjo
end

for _gaF, _gZ0 in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do

end
end
return
end
end

local function _glV()
if onSelf then return _gCA() end

local function _gmK(_gCB, n, t)
local _gDl = (_gCB / n) * math.pi * 2
if mode == _h5("PzIzZoc") then
return CFrame.new(math.cos(_gDl + t * speed) * radius, height, math.sin(_gDl + t * speed) * radius)
elseif mode == _h5("JC8jYZLN9g") then
local _gED = _gCB / n
local _gXQ = radius * (0.3 + _gED)
return CFrame.new(math.cos(_gDl * 2 + t * speed * 2) * _gXQ, height * 2 * _gED * 3, math.sin(_gDl * 2 + t * speed * 2) * _gXQ)
elseif mode == _h5("Jyk/aIA") then
local side = (_gCB % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
local _gED = math.ceil(_gCB / 2) / math.ceil(n / 2)
return CFrame.new(side * (2 + _gED * radius * 0.6), height + math.sin(t * speed * 3 + _gED * 2) * 2, 1.5 + _gED * 1.5)
elseif mode == _h5("IzQwfYA") then
local _gXQ = radius * (0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * speed + _gCB))
return CFrame.new(math.cos(_gDl - t * speed) * _gXQ, height + math.sin(t * speed * 2 + _gCB) * 1.5, math.sin(_gDl - t * speed) * _gXQ)
elseif mode == _h5("My8zfZI") then
return CFrame.new(math.sin(t * speed * 2 + _gCB * 0.5) * 3, height + _gCB * 1.2, -2 - _gCB * 0.6)
else 
return CFrame.new(0, height + math.sin(_gDl) * radius * 0.6, -radius + math.cos(_gDl) * radius * 0.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, t * speed)
end
end
local function loop()
local t0 = tick()
while running do
local root = _glV()
local _gNO = _ggJ()
if root and #_gNO > 0 then
for _gCB, p in ipairs(_gNO) do
local _gwR = p:FindFirstChild(_h5("IyUlTIbb69Kz/luJAiE8ag"))
if _gwR then
local _gZp = (root.CFrame + (onSelf and Vector3.new() or _gWd.predictLead(root))) * _gmK(_gCB, #_gNO, tick() - t0)
task.spawn(function() pcall(function() _gwR:InvokeServer(_gZp) end) end)
end
end
end
task.wait(0.1)
end
end

local function _gnu()
if #_ggJ() >= _gQg.count then return _ggJ() end
local c, r, _gwz = char(), _gCA(), hum()
if not (c and r and _gwz) then return {} end
local home = r.CFrame
pcall(function() RE[_h5("QQM9apKY6+Oy5XT+Aw")]:FireServer(_h5("Myw0boHo9duN+He/Aw")) end)
task.wait(0.8)
if not _grx(_h5("IDI+f77I8tKv")) then _gLy(_h5("IDI+f77I8tKv")) task.wait(0.5) end
local _gZN = _grx(_h5("IDI+f77I8tKv")); if _gZN then _gwz:EquipTool(_gZN) end
task.wait(0.4)
pcall(function() RE[_h5("QQM9apKY6+Oy5XT+Aw")]:FireServer(_h5("IiUgepba7d6z7Ui9HzAfbp7M"), _h5("Mik2SIbH28Kz4X29"), _h5("Mik2")) end)
task.wait(0.4)
for _gAl = 1, _gQg.count do
if not _gQg.running then break end
local t = c:FindFirstChild(_h5("IDI+f77I8tKv")) and c.PropMaker:FindFirstChild(_h5("JC8+Y6z569itx3mkFQ"))
if t then pcall(function() t:FireServer(_grl:FindFirstChild(_h5("PS81ap8")) and _grl.Model:FindFirstChild(_h5("My8jYZbb0d6x5ms")), home.Position) end) end
task.wait(0.9)
end
r.CFrame = home
return _ggJ()
end
local function _glV()
local p = _gQg.sel and _gxh:FindFirstChild(_gQg.sel)
if p and not _gWd.canHit(p) then return nil end
return p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild(_h5("ODU8bp3G8NOP5Xe7ICEjew"))
end

local function spin(_gLO, _gHy, _gKt, radius)
local t0 = tick()
while _gQg.running and (_gKt == nil or tick() - t0 < _gKt) do
local tr = _gHy()
if tr then
local _gzW = tr.Position
if _gHy ~= _gCA then _gzW = _gzW + _gWd.predictLead(tr) end  
local t = tick() - t0
for _gCB, p in ipairs(_gLO) do
local _gDl = (_gCB / #_gLO) * math.pi * 2 + t * 40
local pos
if radius <= 0 then  
pos = _gzW + Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 50 + _gCB) * 0.4, math.sin(t * 37 + _gCB) * 0.4, math.cos(t * 43 + _gCB) * 0.4)
else
pos = _gzW + Vector3.new(math.cos(_gDl) * radius, math.sin(t * 25 + _gCB) * 2, math.sin(_gDl) * radius)
end
_gZR(p, CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(t * 90 + _gCB, t * 70, t * 110))
end
end
_gci.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
end
local function run(_gwD)
if _gQg.running then _gQg.running = false task.wait(0.3) end
_gQg.running = true
task.spawn(function()
local _gLO = _gnu()
if #_gLO == 0 then _gXJ(_h5("NxQQL7vc+w"), _h5("PoPyYNPK9tmu73+6GWAif5Le99avqmi9HzAi")) _gQg.running = false return end
pcall(_gwD, _gLO)
_gQg.running = false
end)
end

local function _gmt()
run(function(_gLO)
local _gzz, standSince = false, nil
while _gQg.running do
local _gxN = _gQg.sel and _gxh:FindFirstChild(_gQg.sel)
local tr = _glV()
local _gJV = _gxN and _gxN.Character and _gxN.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(_h5("ODU8bp3G8NM"))
local r = _gCA()
if not (tr and _gJV and r) then break end
if _gJV.Sit then
_gzz, standSince = true, nil
for _gAl, p in ipairs(_gLO) do _gZR(p, r.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)) end
elseif not _gzz then
for _gAl, p in ipairs(_gLO) do _gZR(p, tr.CFrame + _gWd.predictLead(tr)) end
else
standSince = standSince or tick()
for _gAl, p in ipairs(_gLO) do _gZR(p, _gdl) end
if tick() - standSince > 1.5 then break end
end
_gci.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if _gQg.running then stopAll() end
end)
end

local function _gjt()
run(function(_gLO)
local up, last = false, tick()
local ax, ay, az = 0, 0, 0  
while _gQg.running do
local _gcK = tick(); local _gHt = math.min(_gcK - last, 0.1); last = _gcK
local _gxN = _gQg.sel and _gxh:FindFirstChild(_gQg.sel)
local tr = _glV()
local _gJV = _gxN and _gxN.Character and _gxN.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(_h5("ODU8bp3G8NM"))
local r = _gCA()
if not (tr and _gJV and r) then break end
if _gJV.Sit then up = true end
ax = (ax + 90 * _gHt) % (2 * math.pi)  
ay = (ay + 70 * _gHt) % (2 * math.pi)
az = (az + 110 * _gHt) % (2 * math.pi)
if not up then
for _gCB, p in ipairs(_gLO) do _gZR(p, (tr.CFrame + _gWd.predictLead(tr)) * CFrame.new(math.sin(ax + _gCB) * 1.5, 0, math.cos(ax + _gCB) * 1.5) * CFrame.Angles(ax, ay, az)) end
else
for _gCB, p in ipairs(_gLO) do _gZR(p, CFrame.new(r.Position.X + _gCB * 0.4, 2500, r.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(ax, ay, az)) end
end
_gci.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if _gQg.running then stopAll() end
end)
end

local function _gdt()
S.on = false
S.gen = S.gen + 1
for _gAl, c in ipairs(S.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
for _gAl, _gCB in ipairs(S.insts) do pcall(function() _gCB:Destroy() end) end
for p, m in pairs(S.mats) do pcall(function() p.Material = m end) end
for p, r in pairs(S.refl) do pcall(function() p.Reflectance = r end) end
if S.saved then
for _gED, v in pairs(S.saved) do pcall(function() Lighting[_gED] = v end) end
end
S.conns, S.insts, S.mats, S.refl, S.saved = {}, {}, {}, {}, nil
end

local function _gys(_gmr, p)

local function _gAG(_gmr, p)

end

function E.applySpeed()

if not t then return end
pcall(function()

local _gCw = (S.reverse and -1 or 1) * (S.pingpong and (E.dir or 1) or 1)

t:AdjustSpeed(S.speed * _gCw)
if _gCw == -1 and not E.ppFlip and t.TimePosition < 0.1 and t.Length > 0 then t.TimePosition = t.Length - 0.05 end
end)
end

end
local function _gMG(animator, id, timeout)
local _gzm = Instance.new(_h5("MS44YpLd8Niz"))
_gzm.AnimationId = (type(id) == _h5("AzQjZp3O") and id:find(_h5("Sm9+"), 1, true)) and id or (_h5("AiIpboDa/MO07iLgXw") .. tostring(id))
if timeout then pcall(function() game:GetService(_h5("My8/e5bH7eev5W6mFCUj")):PreloadAsync({ _gzm }) end) end
local _gqK, tr = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(_gzm) end)
if not _gqK or not tr then return nil end
local t0, _gxG = os.clock(), timeout or _gpb.LoadTimeout
while tr.Length == 0 and os.clock() - t0 < _gxG do task.wait(0.05) end
if tr.Length == 0 then pcall(function() tr:Destroy() end); return nil end
return tr
end
function E.record(id)
S.lastEmote = id
local _gCB = table.find(S.recents, id); if _gCB then table.remove(S.recents, _gCB) end
table.insert(S.recents, 1, id)
while #S.recents > 30 do table.remove(S.recents) end
S.stats[id] = (S.stats[id] or 0) + 1
_grR()
end
function E.play(id, _geP)
id = tonumber(id)
if not id or id == 0 then return false end
local _gAl, hum, animator = E.parts()
if not animator or hum.Health <= 0 then notify(_h5("NTIjYA"), _h5("ICUjfJzH+NC45zihs+M+L5ba7XR8qmi9Hy4lYA")); return false end
E.token += 1
local _gcJ = E.token
if E.track then pcall(function() E.track:Stop(0) end); E.track = nil end
local track
if not E.viaEmote[id] then track = _gMG(animator, id) end
if _gcJ ~= E.token then if track then pcall(function() track:Destroy() end) end; return false end
if not track then

local _gqK, _gsU, tr = pcall(function() return hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(id) end)
if _gqK and _gsU and tr then
track = tr; E.viaEmote[id] = true
pcall(function() local _gDl = tr.Animation; local n = _gDl and _gTM(_gDl.AnimationId) or 0; if n ~= 0 and n ~= id then E.animOf[id] = n end end)
end
end
if _gcJ ~= E.token then return false end
if not track then
notify(_h5("PoPyYNPK+MWv73+gBQ"), _h5("OQRx") .. id .. _h5("UKLRm9PN9tmyqmi9GTYwa5yJ9sL95NtsH2CSptP7qILy63amHSGSqDAK9g"))
sound(_h5("FTIjYIE"))
return false
end
pcall(function() track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4 end)
pcall(function() track.Looped = S.loop end)
E.track = track
E.dir = 1
track.Stopped:Connect(function() if E.track == track then E.track = nil end end)
if not track.IsPlaying then pcall(function() track:Play(0.1) end) end
E.applySpeed()
if not _geP then E.record(id) end
return true
end
function E.runSeq(ids, delay, _gQx)
if #ids == 0 then return end
E.seqId += 1
local _gcJ = E.seqId
task.spawn(function()
repeat
for _gAl, id in ipairs(ids) do
if E.seqId ~= _gcJ then return end
E.play(id)
local t0 = os.clock()
while E.seqId == _gcJ and os.clock() - t0 < delay do task.wait(0.1) end
end
until (not _gQx) or E.seqId ~= _gcJ
end)
end
function E.stopSeq() E.seqId += 1 end
function E.pool()
local pool = {}
for _gAl, t in ipairs(_gIj) do for _gAl, r in ipairs(t.ids) do local id = _gTM(r); if id ~= 0 then pool[#pool + 1] = id end end end
for _gAl, id in ipairs(S.favs) do pool[#pool + 1] = id end
for _gAl, id in ipairs(S.customEmotes) do pool[#pool + 1] = id end
for _gAl, t in ipairs(S.userTabs) do for _gAl, id in ipairs(t.ids) do pool[#pool + 1] = id end end
return pool
end
function E.random()
local pool = E.pool()
if #pool > 0 then E.play(pool[math.random(#pool)]) end
end

end

function UI.placePopup(pop, _gwm)
task.defer(function()
if not pop.Parent or not _gwm.Parent then return end
local _gxp = workspace.CurrentCamera
local _gM3 = _gxp and _gxp.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
local _gHm, _gbn = _gwm.AbsolutePosition, _gwm.AbsoluteSize
local w, _gwz = pop.AbsoluteSize.X, pop.AbsoluteSize.Y
local x = math.clamp(_gHm.X, 8, math.max(8, _gM3.X - w - 8))
local y = _gHm.Y + _gbn.Y + 5
if y + _gwz > _gM3.Y - 8 then y = math.max(8, _gHm.Y - _gwz - 5) end
pop.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
end)
end

function UI.loadPack(ctx, _gUp)
if not ctx.pack and ctx.bundleId then ctx.pack = _guM(_h5("Aw") .. tostring(ctx.bundleId)) end
if ctx.pack then _gUp(ctx.pack); return end
if not ctx.bundleId then _gUp(nil, _h5("ACEyZNPA99O0+WigHoP8eZbF")); return end
task.spawn(function()
local p, err = Store.resolve(ctx.bundleId, ctx.name)
if not p then _gUp(nil, err); return end
ctx.pack = p; _gUp(p)
end)
end
function UI.ensurePack(ctx, _gUp)
if not ctx.pack and ctx.bundleId then ctx.pack = _guM(_h5("Aw") .. tostring(ctx.bundleId)) end
if ctx.pack then

if ctx.bundleId and not _guM(ctx.pack.key) then table.insert(S.savedPacks, 1, ctx.pack); _grR() end
_gUp(ctx.pack); return
end
if not ctx.bundleId then return end
task.spawn(function()
notify(_h5("ICEyZA"), _h5("AiUiYJ/f/Nm55Tg") .. tostring(ctx.name) .. _h5("Xm5/"))
local p, err = Store.resolve(ctx.bundleId, ctx.name)
if not p then notify(_h5("NTIjYA"), tostring(err)); sound(_h5("FTIjYIE")); return end
for _gCB, sp in ipairs(S.savedPacks) do if sp.key == p.key then table.remove(S.savedPacks, _gCB); break end end
table.insert(S.savedPacks, 1, p); _grR()
ctx.pack = p
_gUp(p)
end)
end

local G = { t = {}, fired = false }
local function _gty()
if G.fired then return end
local _gM3 = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
local _gtJ, _gW4 = _gM3.Y * _gpb.GestureDist, _gM3.Y * _gpb.GestureZone
local _gqK, _gXV = 0, 0
for _gMC, d in pairs(G.t) do
if d.y0 <= _gW4 and (_gMC.Position.Y - d.y0) >= _gtJ then _gqK += 1 end
if d.t0 > _gXV then _gXV = d.t0 end
end
if _gqK >= 2 then
G.fired = true 
if os.clock() - _gXV >= _gpb.GestureMinTime then UI.reveal() end 
end
end

end
if _gCB.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or _gCB.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
_gnl.hover(_gCB.Position.X, _gCB.Position.Y)
end
end)

_gnl.hover(_gCB.Position.X, _gCB.Position.Y)
elseif _gCB.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
_gnl.hover(_gCB.Position.X, _gCB.Position.Y)
end
end)

end

end)

{ __index = S.real })
function _gPh.restore(c)
c = c or _gPh.c; if not c then return end
for _gED, m in pairs({ waist = c.waist, neck = c.neck, rootJ = c.rootJ }) do
if m and c.o[_gED] then pcall(function() m.C0 = c.o[_gED] end) end
end
for _gAl, L in pairs(c.legs or {}) do
if L.ik then pcall(function() L.ik.Weight = 0 end); L.w = 0 end
end
if c.hum and c.camBase then pcall(function() c.hum.CameraOffset = c.camBase + _gTc.off + _ggi.off end) end
_gPh.bob = Vector3.zero
if c.dust then pcall(function() c.dust.Enabled = false end) end
end
function _gPh.reset()
local c = _gPh.c
if c then
_gPh.restore(c)
if c.conn then pcall(function() c.conn:Disconnect() end) end
for _gAl, L in pairs(c.legs or {}) do
if L.ik then pcall(function() L.ik:Destroy() end) end
end
if c.targets then pcall(function() c.targets:Destroy() end) end
if c.dustAtt then pcall(function() c.dustAtt:Destroy() end) end
end
_gPh.c = nil
_gPh.fall, _gPh.landPos, _gPh.landVel, _gPh.clean = 0, 0, 0, true
_gPh.pf, _gPh.acc, _gPh.bob, _gPh.bobPh = 0, 0, Vector3.zero, 0
_gPh.gl = { t = 1.5, yaw = 0, pit = 0, hold = false }
_gPh.pdist = 0
if _gPh.splash then pcall(function() _gPh.splash.part:Destroy() end); _gPh.splash = nil end
for _gAl, p in ipairs(_gPh.prints) do pcall(function() p:Destroy() end) end
_gPh.prints = {}
for _gED in pairs(_gPh.sm) do _gPh.sm[_gED] = 0 end
end
function _gPh.setup(char)
_gPh.reset()
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass(_h5("ODU8bp3G8NM"))
local root = char:FindFirstChild(_h5("ODU8bp3G8NOP5Xe7ICEjew"))
if not hum or not root then return end
local r6 = hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
local function _gBD(part, name)
local p = char:FindFirstChild(part); return p and p:FindFirstChild(name)
end
local c = {
char = char, hum = hum, root = root, camBase = hum.CameraOffset, r6 = r6,
waist = (not r6) and _gBD(_h5("JTAhaoH99sWu5Q"), _h5("JyE4fIc")) or nil,
neck = r6 and _gBD(_h5("JC8jfJw"), _h5("PiUyZA")) or _gBD(_h5("OCUwaw"), _h5("PiUyZA")), 
rootJ = (not r6) and _gBD(_h5("PC8maoH99sWu5Q"), _h5("Ii8+ew")) or nil,
o = {}, legs = {},
}
for _gED, m in pairs({ waist = c.waist, neck = c.neck, rootJ = c.rootJ }) do if m then c.o[_gED] = m.C0 end end
local _gTH = char:FindFirstChild(_h5("PC8maoH99sWu5Q"))
for _gAl, side in ipairs({ _h5("PCU3ew"), _h5("Iik2Z4c") }) do
local up, lo, ft = char:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("JTAhaoHl/NA")), char:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("PC8maoHl/NA")), char:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("Ni8+ew"))
local _gaA = _gTH and _gTH:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("OCkh"))
local _gxF = up and up:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("Oy40ag"))
local _gDm = lo and lo:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("MS46Y5Y"))
if up and lo and ft and _gaA and _gxF and _gDm and _gaA:IsA(_h5("PS8lYIGf3Q")) and _gaA.Part0 then
c.legs[side] = {
up = up, lo = lo, ft = ft, hip = _gaA, w = 0,

len = (_gaA.C1.Position - _gxF.C0.Position).Magnitude + (_gxF.C1.Position - _gDm.C0.Position).Magnitude,
ank = _gDm.C1.Position, 
}
end
end
c.params = RaycastParams.new()

c.params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

_gPh.fall = 0
end
end)
_gPh.c = c
_gPh.clean = false
end

p.FilterDescendantsInstances = _gxp and { c.char, _gxp } or { c.char }
p.IgnoreWater = false
c.fparams = p
end
return workspace:Raycast(c.root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(c.hum.HipHeight + c.root.Size.Y / 2 + 2.5), 0), c.fparams)
end
function _gPh.stamp(c, _geA)
local n = _geA.Normal
local _gyQ = c.root.CFrame.RightVector
_gyQ = _gyQ - n * _gyQ:Dot(n)
if _gyQ.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
_gyQ = _gyQ.Unit
local _gxp = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not _gxp then return end
local _gRO = Instance.new(_h5("ICEjew"))
_gRO.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
_gRO.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.55, 0.95) 
_gRO.Anchored, _gRO.CanCollide, _gRO.CanQuery, _gRO.CanTouch, _gRO.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
_gRO.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
_gRO.Color = _ggh[_geA.Material]
_gRO.Transparency = 0.3
_gRO.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(_geA.Position + n * 0.03 + _gyQ * (_gPh.side * 0.55), n, _gyQ)
_gRO.Parent = _gxp
local list = _gPh.prints
list[#list + 1] = _gRO
if #list > 40 then local _gEK = table.remove(list, 1); pcall(function() _gEK:Destroy() end) end
TweenService:Create(_gRO, TweenInfo.new(7, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
Debris:AddItem(_gRO, 7.3)
end

local function _ggA(inst)

end
function _gPh.update(_gHt)
local c = _gPh.c
if not c or not c.char.Parent or c.hum.Health <= 0 then return end
local R = E.perf and _gPh.perfR or S.real
local _gGm = R.footIK or R.lean or R.head or R.breathe or R.land or R.brake or R.dust or R.camBob
or R.headLead or R.glance or R.prints or R.splash or R.shake
if _gGm then _gPh.clean = false elseif _gPh.clean then return end
_gHt = math.min(_gHt, 0.05); _gPh.t += _gHt
local hum, root, sm = c.hum, c.root, _gPh.sm
local state = hum:GetState()
local _gz3 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
local _gUH = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(_gz3)
local speed = Vector3.new(_gz3.X, 0, _gz3.Z).Magnitude
local _glz = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
local _gAT = hum.Sit or hum.PlatformStand or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
local _gqK = (not _gAT) and (E.track == nil) 
local _gDl = 1 - math.exp(-_gHt * 10)
if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then _gPh.fall = math.max(_gPh.fall, -_gz3.Y) end

do
local _ggy = -_gUH.Z
local _gwP = math.clamp((_ggy - _gPh.pf) / math.max(_gHt, 0.001), -300, 300)
_gPh.pf = _ggy
_gPh.acc += (_gwP - _gPh.acc) * (1 - math.exp(-_gHt * 12))
end


local _gdU = speed < 3 and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1
and (state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
local _ga4 = R.footIK and _gqK and _glz and _gdU and not c.r6
if _ga4 and c.ik == nil then _gPh.ensureIK(c) end
local _gGN
if c.ik then
local r = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 3), 0), c.params)
_gGN = r and r.Position.Y
end

local _gOJ, _gfA, _gJJ, _giI, _gr0 = 0, {}, 0, 0, true
for _gAl in pairs(c.legs) do _gOJ += 1 end
if _ga4 and c.ik and _gGN and _gOJ > 0 then
for side, L in pairs(c.legs) do
local fp = L.ft.Position
local _gXQ = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(fp.X, _gGN + R.reach + 0.5, fp.Z), Vector3.new(0, -(R.reach * 2 + 1), 0), c.params)
if _gXQ and _gXQ.Normal.Y >= 0.7 and not _ggA(_gXQ.Instance) then
local d = _gXQ.Position.Y - _gGN
if math.abs(d) <= R.reach then
_gfA[side] = { pos = _gXQ.Position, n = _gXQ.Normal, d = d }; _gJJ += 1; _giI = math.max(_giI, math.abs(d))
else _gr0 = false end
else _gr0 = false end
end
end

if not _gr0 or _gJJ < _gOJ or _giI < 0.05 then _gfA = {}; _gJJ = 0 end

local _gAs = 0
for _gAl, _gwz in pairs(_gfA) do if _gwz.d < _gAs then _gAs = _gwz.d end end
local _gkN = (R.pelvis and _gqK) and _gAs * 0.5 or 0
local _gcA = _gkN - sm.p 

local _gEN, _geK = {}, 0
for side, _gwz in pairs(_gfA) do
local L = c.legs[side]
local n = _gwz.n
local _gyQ = root.CFrame.RightVector
_gyQ = _gyQ - n * _gyQ:Dot(n)
if _gyQ.Magnitude > 0.01 then
_gyQ = _gyQ.Unit
local _gOQ = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, _gyQ, n)
local center = _gwz.pos + n * (L.ft.Size.Y / 2)
local _gEm = center + _gOQ:VectorToWorldSpace(L.ank)
local _gbA = (L.hip.Part0.CFrame * L.hip.C0).Position + Vector3.new(0, _gcA, 0)
if (_gEm - _gbA).Magnitude <= L.len * 0.96 then 
_gEN[side] = CFrame.new(center) * _gOQ; _geK += 1
end
end
end
local _gkm = (_gOJ > 0 and _geK == _gOJ)  
if not _gkm then _gEN = {}; _gkN = 0 end
for side, L in pairs(c.legs) do
if L.ik then
local _gZp = _gEN[side]
if _gZp then L.tp.CFrame = _gZp end
L.w += ((_gZp and 1 or 0) - L.w) * _gDl
L.ik.Weight = L.w
L.ik.Enabled = L.w > 0.01
end
end
sm.p += (_gkN - sm.p) * _gDl

if R.land then
_gPh.landVel += (-120 * _gPh.landPos - 14 * _gPh.landVel) * _gHt
_gPh.landPos += _gPh.landVel * _gHt
else
_gPh.landPos, _gPh.landVel = 0, 0
end

local _gtN, _gKQ = 0, 0
if R.lean and _gqK then
_gtN = -math.clamp(-_gUH.Z * 0.011, -0.15, 0.22) * R.leanAmt 
_gKQ = math.clamp(root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Y * 0.05 - _gUH.X * 0.012, -0.3, 0.3) * R.leanAmt
end

if R.brake and _gqK and _glz then
_gtN += math.clamp(-_gPh.acc * 0.0045, 0, 0.3) * R.leanAmt
end
sm.pitch += (_gtN - sm.pitch) * _gDl; sm.roll += (_gKQ - sm.roll) * _gDl



local _gAB, _gBA = 0, 0
local _gxp = workspace.CurrentCamera
local _gPB = _gTc.first
local _gnI = hum.MoveDirection
local _gSI = _gnI.Magnitude > 0.1
if (R.head or R.headLead or R.glance) and _gqK then

if R.head and _gxp and not _gPB then
local _gEF = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(_gxp.CFrame.LookVector)
_gAB = math.clamp(math.atan2(-_gEF.X, -_gEF.Z), -1.2, 1.2) * 0.85
_gBA = math.clamp(math.asin(math.clamp(_gEF.Y, -1, 1)), -0.6, 0.6) * 0.8
end
if R.headLead and _gSI and not _gPB and hum.AutoRotate and UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
local _gEF = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(_gnI)
local _gxm = math.atan2(-_gEF.X, -_gEF.Z) 
if math.abs(_gxm) < 2.3 then _gAB = math.clamp(_gxm, -1.2, 1.2) * 0.9 end 
end
local gl = _gPh.gl
if R.glance and not _gSI and speed < 0.5 and _glz then
gl.t -= _gHt
if gl.t <= 0 then
if gl.hold then
gl.yaw, gl.pit, gl.hold = 0, 0, false
gl.t = 2.5 + math.random() * 4.5
else
gl.yaw = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.75
gl.pit = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.25
gl.hold = true
gl.t = 0.8 + math.random() * 1.4
end
end
local _gED = _gPB and 0.35 or 1 
local _gay = 1 - math.clamp(math.abs(_gAB) / 0.4, 0, 1) 
_gAB += gl.yaw * _gED * _gay; _gBA += gl.pit * _gED * _gay
else
gl.yaw, gl.pit, gl.hold, gl.t = 0, 0, false, 1.5
end
end
local _gcm = 1 - math.exp(-_gHt * 8)
sm.hy += (_gAB - sm.hy) * _gcm; sm.hp += (_gBA - sm.hp) * _gcm

local _gWo = (R.breathe and _gqK and _glz and speed < 0.5) and math.sin(_gPh.t * 1.8) * 0.012 or 0
sm.br += (_gWo - sm.br) * _gDl

if R.dust and _gqK and _glz and speed > 9 then
local d = _gPh.ensureDust(c)
if d then
d.Rate = math.clamp((speed - 9) * 3, 0, 26)
local _ghI = hum.FloorMaterial
if c.dustMat ~= _ghI then c.dustMat = _ghI; d.Color = ColorSequence.new(_gtc[_ghI] or _guc) end
d.Enabled = true
end
elseif c.dust then
c.dust.Enabled = false
end

local _gAo = Vector3.zero
if R.camBob and _gqK and _glz and speed > 2 then
_gPh.bobPh += _gHt * speed * 0.6
local _gED = math.clamp(speed / 16, 0.3, 1.6) * R.camAmt
_gAo = Vector3.new(math.cos(_gPh.bobPh) * 0.05 * _gED, (math.abs(math.sin(_gPh.bobPh)) - 0.5) * 0.12 * _gED, 0)
end
_gPh.bob = _gPh.bob:Lerp(_gAo, _gDl)
if _gPh.bob.Magnitude > 0.0005 or _gPh.bobOn then
_gPh.bobOn = _gPh.bob.Magnitude > 0.0005
pcall(function() hum.CameraOffset = c.camBase + _gTc.off + _ggi.off + _gPh.bob end)
end

local _gIw
if (R.prints or R.splash) and not _gAT and speed > 2.5 then _gIw = _gPh.floorRay(c) end
if R.splash and _gIw and _gIw.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
local _goT = _gPh.ensureSplash()
if _goT then
_goT.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(_gIw.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0))
_goT.pe.Rate = math.clamp(speed * 2.2, 6, 34)
_goT.pe.Enabled = true
end
elseif _gPh.splash and _gPh.splash.pe.Enabled then
_gPh.splash.pe.Enabled = false
end
if R.prints and _gqK and _glz and _gIw and _ggh[_gIw.Material] then
_gPh.pdist += speed * _gHt
if _gPh.pdist >= 2.2 then _gPh.pdist = 0; _gPh.side = -_gPh.side; _gPh.stamp(c, _gIw) end
end

local o = c.o
if c.rootJ and o.rootJ then c.rootJ.C0 = o.rootJ * CFrame.new(0, sm.p + _gPh.landPos, 0) end
if c.waist and o.waist then c.waist.C0 = o.waist * CFrame.Angles(sm.pitch + sm.br + _gPh.landPos * 0.5, 0, sm.roll) end

if c.neck and o.neck then

c.neck.C0 = CFrame.new(o.neck.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, sm.hy, 0)
* CFrame.Angles(sm.hp - sm.pitch * 0.5, 0, -sm.roll * 0.5) * o.neck.Rotation
end

if not _gGm then
local m = math.abs(sm.p) + math.abs(sm.pitch) + math.abs(sm.roll) + math.abs(sm.hy) + math.abs(sm.hp) + math.abs(sm.br) + math.abs(_gPh.landPos)
for _gAl, L in pairs(c.legs) do m += L.w end
m += _gPh.bob.Magnitude
if m < 0.002 then _gPh.restore(c); _gPh.clean = true end
end
end
UI.conns[#UI.conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(_gHt)
local _gqK, err = pcall(_gPh.update, _gHt)
if not _gqK and not _gPh.warned then _gPh.warned = true; warn(_h5("KwcFTtPs9Nip71C6Eh1xfZbI9d6u53f1UA") .. tostring(err)) end
end)

elseif (not _gZ3) and _gTc.first then _gTc.goOut(true) end

local function _gBp(_gHt)
local _gxp = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not _gxp then return end
local R = E.perf and _gPh.perfR or S.real

local _gMJ = _gTc.neck
if _gMJ and _gMJ.Part0 and F.followAmt > 0 then
local base = (_gMJ.Part0.CFrame * _gMJ.C0).Rotation
local d = base * _gMJ.Transform.Rotation * base:Inverse()
_gOQ = CFrame.new():Lerp(d, F.followAmt) * _gOQ
end

local sm = _gPh.sm
_gOQ = CFrame.Angles(0, sm.hy * F.followAmt, 0) * _gOQ * CFrame.Angles(sm.hp * F.followAmt, 0, 0)
end

local _gED = F.motion
local _gAo, _gKQ = Vector3.zero, 0
if _gED > 0 and (F.follow or not R.camBob) then
if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and speed > 2 then
_gTc.ph += _gHt * speed * 0.6
local _gwF = math.clamp(speed / 16, 0.3, 1.6) * _gED
_gAo = Vector3.new(math.cos(_gTc.ph) * 0.04 * _gwF, (math.abs(math.sin(_gTc.ph)) - 0.5) * 0.1 * _gwF, 0)
end
_gKQ = -math.clamp(root.CFrame.RightVector:Dot(_gFN) / 16, -1.5, 1.5) * 0.04 * _gED
end
_gTc.bob = _gTc.bob:Lerp(_gAo, _gDl)
_gTc.roll += (_gKQ - _gTc.roll) * _gDl
else
_gTc.bob, _gTc.roll = Vector3.zero, 0
end

local _gJQ = 0
if _gb4 then
_gJQ = math.clamp(root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Y * 0.04, -0.14, 0.14) * math.clamp(speed / 16, 0, 1.2) * R.leanAmt
end
_glb.roll += (_gJQ - _glb.roll) * (1 - math.exp(-_gHt * 6))

local sp, _gBU, _gJT, _guD = 0, 0, 0, 0
if _glb.amp > 0 then
local t, _gED = _glb.t, _glb.amp
sp = math.sin(t * 52) * _gED * 0.03
_gBU = math.sin(t * 43 + 1.3) * _gED * 0.02
_gJT = math.sin(t * 37 + 2.1) * _gED * 0.025
_guD = (math.sin(t * 58) * 0.04 - 0.22) * _gED
end
local _gAp = _gOQ * CFrame.Angles(sp, _gBU, (_gTc.first and _gTc.roll or 0) + _glb.roll + _gJT)
_gxp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, _guD, 0) + _gAp:VectorToWorldSpace(_gTc.bob)) * _gAp
end
pcall(function() RunService:BindToRenderStep(_h5("NQgOSaP2yeWY"), Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, _gzp) end)
pcall(function() RunService:BindToRenderStep(_h5("NQgOSaM"), Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, _gBp) end)

end

local _gGc = { last = {}, any = 0, fall = 0, runT = 0, conns = {}, hp = 100, lowHp = false }
function _gGc.unhook()
for _gAl, _gZq in ipairs(_gGc.conns) do pcall(function() _gZq:Disconnect() end) end
_gGc.conns = {}
end
local function _gIu(key)
local cfg = S.ev[key]
if not cfg or not cfg.on then return end
local _gcK = os.clock()
if _gcK - (_gGc.last[key] or 0) < S.evCd or _gcK - _gGc.any < 0.8 then return end
local _gAl, hum = E.parts()
if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or E.track ~= nil then return end 
local id = cfg.emote
if id == 0 then
local pool = E.pool()
id = pool[math.random(math.max(#pool, 1))]
end
if not id then return end
_gGc.last[key], _gGc.any = _gcK, _gcK
task.spawn(E.play, id, true)
end
function _gGc.hook(char, hum)
_gGc.unhook()
_gGc.fall, _gGc.runT, _gGc.lowHp, _gGc.hp = 0, 0, false, hum.Health
local function add(_gZq) _gGc.conns[#_gGc.conns + 1] = _gZq end
add(hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_gEK, new)
local _gHj = Enum.HumanoidStateType
if new == _gHj.Jumping then _gIu(_h5("GjU8fw"))
elseif new == _gHj.Landed then
local _gUu = _gGc.fall; _gGc.fall = 0
if _gUu >= S.evLandMin then _gIu(_h5("HCE/aw")) end
elseif new == _gHj.Swimming then _gIu(_h5("Azc4Yg"))
elseif _gEK == _gHj.Swimming then _gIu(_h5("Azc4YrbH/Q")) end
end))
add(hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal(_h5("Iykl")):Connect(function() _gIu(hum.Sit and _h5("Aykl") or _h5("AzQwYZc")) end))
add(char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(_glq) if _glq:IsA(_h5("JC8+Yw")) then _gIu(_h5("FTEkZoM")) end end))
add(char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(_glq) if _glq:IsA(_h5("JC8+Yw")) then _gIu(_h5("BS40fobA6Q")) end end))
add(hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(_gwz)
if _gwz < _gGc.hp - 0.5 and _gwz > 0 then _gIu(_h5("GDUjew")) end
local _gYx = _gwz / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)
if _gYx < 0.3 and _gwz > 0 and not _gGc.lowHp then _gGc.lowHp = true; _gIu(_h5("HC8m"))
elseif _gYx > 0.5 then _gGc.lowHp = false end
_gGc.hp = _gwz
end))
end

elseif sp < 1.5 then

_gGc.runT = 0
end
end)

local function _gKr(on)
pcall(function()

local function update(_gHt)
if not active then return end
_gxp = _grl.CurrentCamera
local _gZI = Vector3.zero
if not _gNk:GetFocusedTextBox() then
if _gNk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
if _gNk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
if _gNk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
if _gNk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
if _gNk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
if _gNk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end
end
if _gAM.F then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
if _gAM.B then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
if _gAM.L then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
if _gAM.R then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
if _gAM.U then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
if _gAM.D then _gZI = _gZI + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end
local _gOQ = CFrame.fromOrientation(pitch, yaw, 0)
local dir = _gOQ:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(_gZI.X, 0, _gZI.Z)) + Vector3.new(0, _gZI.Y, 0)
if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit end
local _gTy = dir * speed
if _gdT then _gz3 = _gz3:Lerp(_gTy, 1 - math.exp(-8 * _gHt)) else _gz3 = _gTy end
_gyp = CFrame.new(_gyp.Position + _gz3 * _gHt) * _gOQ
_gxp.CFrame = _gyp
_gxp.FieldOfView = fov
end
local function stop()
if not active then return end
active = false
pcall(function() _gci:UnbindFromRenderStep(_gqi) end)
pcall(function() _gmb:UnbindAction(_gb) end)
_gKr(true)
if saved then
_gxp.CameraType = saved.ct
_gxp.CameraSubject = saved.subj
_gxp.FieldOfView = saved.fov
saved = nil
end
_gz3, _gPQ, _gEQ = Vector3.zero, nil, false
for _gED in pairs(_gAM) do _gAM[_gED] = false end
_gCM.Visible = false
_gJn.Text = _h5("My88ajAO+MU")
end
